about_the_game:
Adds a selection of background music from previous Gust titles that can be used when changing the in-game BGM.

Note:
- BGM tracks can be used by selecting "Change BGM" on the save menu.
- The name, details, and release date of this content are subject to change.
- This product is part of "The Red Alchemist & the White Guardian - Atelier Season Pass." Please be aware that there are other products which contain this content. Be careful not to make duplicate purchases.
- Please check the official site for details.
